personality_one_liner: An energetic, motivating, and highly tactile coaching companion that turns daily discipline into a vibrant, rewarding game.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (44pt min), playful padding, use controlled asymmetry and avoid dense, purely utilitarian lists.

do's: Modal scrims and floating action buttons (FABs)

screens.name: Auth
screens.layout: Hero photo spanning the top 50% with a gradient top-to-bottom scrim. Large display text below hero ('Raggiungi i tuoi obiettivi'). Google Sign-In button pinned to the bottom (sticky) with safe-area clearance.

screens.name: Onboarding Chat
screens.purpose: Conversational flow where AI collects goal, timeline, constraints, and budget.

states.loading: Typing indicator (3 dots) in chat bubble

screens.layout: Full-screen chat interface. Pinned glass header with AI avatar and 'Coach' title. Chat bubbles: AI uses surfaceSecondary, user uses brandSecondary. Input field at bottom wrapped in KeyboardAvoidingView, showing suggested prompt pills ('Voglio dimagrire', 'Migliorare nel lavoro') before typing.

screens.name: Home Plan
screens.purpose: Primary dashboard showing active goal progress and daily action plan.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero card and 3 task rows
states.empty: Illustration of calendar + 'Nessun piano oggi, parla con il coach' CTA

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top section: Hero card with abstract energetic background, showing the main goal, a large circular progress ring, and days remaining. Below: 'Oggi' section. Stacked chunky cards for each daily task. Task cards have a large checkbox on the left, title and time slot on the right, and metric pill (e.g., '20/50'). FAB in bottom right for 'Daily Check-in'.

screens.name: Task Detail Modal
screens.purpose: Log precise metrics or quantities for a specific daily action.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet (using @gorhom/bottom-sheet). Oversized numeric input for metrics (e.g., 'Quanti KM hai corso?'). A large sticky primary CTA ('Salva') at the bottom.

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: Weekly milestones view and metric charts.

states.empty: Illustration of climbing a mountain + 'Inizia a completare i task' text

screens.layout: Top section: Tab selector (Settimana / Mese). Scrollable list of milestones (using timeline pattern with vertical divider and nodes). Charts use thick, tactile lines and brandPrimary color.

auth_hero.alt: Silhouette of people running in bright motivating sunlight

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality. The design must feel energetic, bouncy, and rewarding, not like a dull corporate tracker.
Do not use any blue, indigo, or purple colors. The main brand color is a vibrant orange (#FF6B35) paired with a deep charcoal text (#111418) for high contrast and energy.
For the daily task list, ensure the hitSlop on the checkboxes is generous (at least 44x44pt). Use chunky padding (md/lg) on the task cards.
When placing text over the 'auth_hero' or 'hero_background' images, a gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom, transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) is MANDATORY to guarantee readability.
The AI onboarding chat should feel conversational and frictionless. Use suggested prompts as pill buttons just above the input field to get the user started.
Always pin the primary CTA (like 'Salva' on the Task Detail Modal) to the bottom of the screen, clearing the safe area.
